title: Dummy Backdoor as a Defense: Removing Unknown Backdoors via Shared Internal Mechanisms for Generative LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.11648v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the safety and reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs), as they cause models to behave normally on clean inputs while producing attacker-specified responses when hidden triggers are present. Removing such unknown backdoors is particularly challenging when the defender does not know the attack types or the internal mechanisms formed during backdoor training. In this work, we propose a simple but effective backdoor removal method based on internal mechanisms shared across different backdoors. First, we show that different backdoors with the same task (attack objective) induce similar trigger-activated changes in their internal activations. Motivated by this observation, our proposed method intentionally embeds a backdoor with a known trigger dummy backdoor and then removes it through further fine-tuning on dummy-triggered inputs paired with clean responses. translated_title: 虚拟后门作为防御手段：通过共享内部机制消除生成式大语言模型中的未知后门
translated_abstract: 后门攻击对大语言模型（LLM）的安全性和可靠性构成严重威胁，因为此类攻击使模型在干净输入上表现正常，而当隐藏触发器存在时则会产生攻击者指定的响应。当防御者不了解攻击类型或后门训练期间形成的内部机制时，移除此类未知后门尤其具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种简单而有效的后门移除方法，该方法基于不同后门之间共享的内部机制。首先，我们证明了具有相同任务（攻击目标）的不同后门会在其内部激活中引发相似的触发器激活变化。受这一观察结果的启发，我们提出的方法有意植入一个具有已知触发器的后门（即虚拟后门），然后通过在虚拟触发器输入与干净响应配对的数据上进行进一步微调来将其移除。由于虚拟后门与未知后门……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文利用相同攻击目标的后门会引发相似内部激活变化这一发现，提出先植入已知触发器的虚拟后门、再通过虚拟触发器输入与干净响应配对微调将其消除的方法，从而在无需了解攻击类型的情况下移除生成式大语言模型中的未知后门。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes removing unknown backdoors from generative LLMs by intentionally implanting a dummy backdoor with a known trigger and then unlearning it through fine-tuning on dummy-triggered inputs paired with clean responses, exploiting the internal activation mechanisms shared across backdoors with the same attack objective.
